title: Generalized Fidelity, the Data Processing Inequality, and Convexity
summary: In this paper, we show that the generalized Bures--Wasserstein distance induced by the generalized fidelity fails the data processing inequality (DPI) in every dimension $n\geq2$. In dimension two, we derive three sufficient conditions guaranteeing the DPI by using an explicit formula for the real part of the generalized fidelity. Furthermore, we find a necessary and sufficient condition under which the generalized fidelity reduces to the Uhlmann fidelity.
